title: Textbooks Are All You Need II: phi-1.5 technical report

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety scores based on scaled perplexity and sentence toxicity using a subset of the ToxiGen dataset for demographics including Asian, Black, Chinese, Latino, Mexican, Middle-Eastern, and Native American, alongside manual grading of 86 custom boundary-probing prompts.
Evaluating safety scores based on scaled perplexity and sentence toxicity using a subset of the ToxiGen dataset for Jewish and Muslim demographics, alongside manual grading of custom prompts.

Evaluating safety scores based on scaled perplexity and sentence toxicity using a subset of the ToxiGen dataset for mental and physical disability demographics, alongside manual grading of custom prompts.
Evaluating safety scores based on scaled perplexity and sentence toxicity using a subset of the ToxiGen dataset for women, alongside manual grading of custom prompts.
Evaluating safety scores based on scaled perplexity and sentence toxicity using a subset of the ToxiGen dataset for the LGBTQ demographic, alongside manual grading of custom prompts.
